nodes.dialogue_text: You are not Radha's son, nor are you a Suta. You are my firstborn, sired by Surya the Sun God. You are the eldest Pandava. Join your brothers, Karna.
Mother...? You abandoned me to the river when I was born. It was a charioteer who raised me. And it was Duryodhana who gave me honor when the world spat on my caste.

choices.choice_text: [Embrace her, but refuse to switch sides.]

nodes.dialogue_text: I cannot abandon Duryodhana now; that would be the ultimate betrayal. But I make you this promise, Mother: I will not kill Yudhishthira, Bhima, Nakula, or Sahadeva. I will only fight Arjuna. Whatever happens, you will still have five sons.
